text: Official CLI can scan a GitHub repo and only report verified secrets
quote: trufflehog github --only-verified --repo https://github.com/trufflesecurity/test_keys

text: Classifies over 800 secret types and maps them to the identity they belong to
quote: trufflehog classifies over 800 secret types, mapping them back to the specific identity they belong to

text: For every classifiable secret, can attempt a live login to confirm it's actually valid
quote: for every secret trufflehog can classify, it can also log in to confirm if that secret is live or not

text: Analyze command investigates a secret's creator, accessible resources, and permissions
quote: TruffleHog Analyze evaluates access patterns to identify a secret’s metadata, permissions, and resources.

text: Provides pre-commit hook integration to stop secrets before they're pushed
quote: Pre-commit hooks are a useful way to prevent secrets in code from being pushed from a git repository.

text: Supports custom regex-based secret detectors with optional webhook verification
quote: The custom regex detector allows you to define your own detector using regular expressions with optional verification using a webhook.

text: CLI flag lets you manually choose which detectors run via --include-detectors
quote: You can manually specify which detectors to use with the `--include-detectors` flag.

text: Can force verification for specific secret types (e.g. AWS, Buildkite) regardless of source verify settings
quote: this trufflehog invocation will force verification for AWS and Buildkite secrets, irrespective of whether the configured sources have their verify flag set

text: Installable via Homebrew (brew install trufflehog)
quote: brew install trufflehog

text: Onboarding flow connects a source and streams findings into a web UI
quote: By the end, you'll have a running scanner, your first source connected, and findings flowing into the web UI.

text: Findings can be routed to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks
quote: Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them.

text: Scans beyond git repos, including comments, Docker images, and other locations
quote: TruffleHog scans beyond code repositories to identify secrets hidden in comments, Docker images, and more.

text: Git scan supports filtering results (verified/unknown) and failing the run via --fail for CI gating
quote: trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail

text: Can run headlessly via Docker container to scan an entire GitHub org
quote: docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD:/pwd" trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest github --org=trufflesecurity

text: Scans many non-git sources: chats, wikis, logs, API testing platforms, object stores, filesystems, and more
quote: TruffleHog can look for secrets in many places including git, chats, wikis, logs, api testing platforms, object stores, filesystems and more

text: Checksums for release artifacts are signed with cosign for supply-chain integrity
quote: Checksums are applied to all artifacts, and the resulting checksum file is signed using cosign.

text: Global git hook setup via core.hooksPath applies hooks to all repos without per-repo config
quote: This approach uses Git's `core.hooksPath` to apply hooks to all repositories without requiring any per-repository setup

text: Documents integration with Husky for managing JS/Node git hooks
quote: Husky is a popular tool for managing Git hooks in JavaScript/Node.js projects.

text: --verify-detectors and --no-verify-detectors flags let you override verification per detector
quote: the `--verify-detectors` and `--no-verify-detectors` CLI flags can be used to configure detector-specific verification override settings

text: Continuously tracks status of exposed keys to detect whether remediation has occurred, with configurable alerts
quote: TruffleHog continuously tracks the status of all key types to identify whether remediation has occurred. Set up alerts across the platform of your choosing and include customized messages for developers to rotate and secure keys.

text: Offers hosted or self-hosted deployment options for the scanner
quote: Choose hosted (managed by Truffle Security) or self-hosted (running in your environment).

text: Can continuously monitor Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and Sharepoint for credentials
quote: Are you interested in continuously monitoring Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, Sharepoint (and more) for credentials?

text: Supports pre-receive git server hooks to block commits containing secrets before they're accepted
quote: If you run your own git server, consider the pre-receive hook option which can block commits with secrets from being accepted.

text: Pre-commit hooks can be bypassed in rare cases with git commit --no-verify
quote: In rare cases, you may need to bypass pre-commit hooks: `git commit --no-verify -m "Your commit message"`

text: Custom regex detector verification is performed via a webhook POST request to a provided endpoint
quote: Verification is done via a webhook POST request to the provided `endpoint`.

text: Product page describes offering SSO (SAML2.0/OAuth2.0) and role-based access control
quote: single sign on saml 2 0 or oauth 2 0 ❌ ✅ role based access control ❌ ✅

text: Config file plus --include-detectors flag lets scans target specific detector types like AWS and GitHub
quote: ./trufflehog scan --config=config.yaml --include-detectors=AWS,GitHub

text: Core tool is a secrets scanner that digs into code repositories to find passwords and sensitive keys
quote: TruffleHog™ is a secrets scanning tool that digs deep into your code repositories to find secrets, passwords, and sensitive keys.
